message: Wow, Mike--that Joyce Carol Oates site is great, and the picture is so helpful! LOL. It's one of my favorites too! Great to teach--students love it. Have you read [Beasts](http://storm.usfca.edu/~southerr/beasts.html) by Oates? I checked it out from the public library last summer and read it on a lark--couldn't put it down.
